india_trends.title: Tata Motors PV Q1 results: Net profit drops to ₹775 crore on weak JLR sales; revenue rises 9%
india_trends.summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles reported weak Q1 FY27 results with a net profit of ₹775 crore, down from ₹3,924 crore last year. Despite a 9% year-on-year increase in revenue to ₹94,827 crore, sequentially it fell by 10%.

india_trends.title: BharatBenz gets Rs 4,000 crore boost as Daimler India expands in Tamil Nadu
india_trends.summary: Daimler India Commercial Vehicles plans a significant Rs 4,000 crore investment in Tamil Nadu. The investment aims to enhance product development and manufacturing capabilities for rising domestic demand.
